## Description

When an owner adds a doctor (and for the owner-doctor in the wizard) they enter authority, number and expiry and attest they have checked it. Store the attesting owner, time and values in the audit (append-only). Remove the Verified, Pending and Rejected states, the Doctors tab verification step, ILicenceReview and the "Verification pending" notice; recording, signing and prescribing no longer depend on VerifiedAt. The doctor list shows "Attested by {owner} on {date}". Expiry reminders stay, and an expired licence asks the owner to re-attest (default: warn, do not block).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an owner adds a doctor, when they do not attest, then the doctor cannot be added.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a doctor was added, when anyone views the list, then it shows who attested and when; the audit holds the values.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an approved organisation, when a doctor with an attested licence records or signs, then it is allowed with no Medvya check.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a licence nears or passes expiry, when the reminder runs, then the owner is told to re-attest.
- [ ] **AC5.** The licence gate tests are replaced by attestation tests; the removed gate is not reachable by any endpoint.

## Notes / open questions

- Clinical safety: a false licence is the organisation's liability, and the owner accepted that there is no independent check, including for controlled drugs (ADR-016); recorded in MDV-P2-021.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
